sentence: This project designs smart bioinks and tests whether they can guide stem cells to form osteochondral tissue when bioprinted.
This project studies which genes help Metrosideros trees adapt to very dry and very wet places.
This project records how four Indigenous language communities name, sort and use arthropods.
This project sets up a three dimensional X-ray microscope to study materials such as snow and ice cores.
This project builds a system where infrastructure and wireless communications help small vehicles such as e-scooters and delivery robots drive themselves.
This project builds a faster and cheaper test for the virus that causes COVID-19 using CRISPR and nanopores.
This project builds an artificial intelligence system that follows wildfires fueled by hurricanes before, during and after the fire.
This project builds nanomagnets driven by a low current that control qubits in spin-based quantum computers with little power.
This project studies ways to measure distances between high-dimensional mathematical objects so that machine learning methods are more efficient and robust.
This project asks whether expanding space, including the inside of black holes, can be described by quantum systems that preserve information.
This project builds a power generator for spacecraft that captures energy from solar wind plasma.
This project designs a dental x-ray bite block that puts less pressure on oral soft tissues while keeping accurate positioning.
This project builds a computer vision system that watches how infants move to spot early movement problems linked to autism.
This project studies how corn plants recycle nutrients from aging leaves, using measurements, gene editing and artificial intelligence to find the genes involved.
This project supports a conference on computational complexity, which studies the limits of efficient algorithms.
